definitions.gloss: war situation; battle conditions; state of the fighting
definitions.explanation: The current state or progress of a war or battle. Also used figuratively for competitive situations.

examples.japanese: {戦況|せんきょう}が{悪化|あっか}した。
{最新|さいしん}の{戦況|せんきょう}がラジオで{伝|つた}えられた。
examples.english: The latest battle conditions were reported on the radio.

examples.japanese: {戦況|せんきょう}が{不利|ふり}になると、{指揮官|しきかん}は{撤退|てったい}を{命|めい}じた。
examples.english: When the battle situation became unfavorable, the commander ordered a retreat.

notes:
Composed of {戦|せん} (war, battle) + {況|きょう} (situation, condition). Primarily used in military and historical contexts, but can also appear in sports commentary and business contexts to describe competitive situations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦況|せんきょう}を{伝|つた}える: to report the war situation
- {戦況|せんきょう}が{悪化|あっか}する: the war situation worsens
- {戦況|せんきょう}が{好転|こうてん}する: the war situation improves
- {戦況|せんきょう}{報告|ほうこく}: battle situation report
- {戦況|せんきょう}を{見守|みまも}る: to watch the battle situation unfold

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {戦局|せんきょく}: the war situation — focuses on the overall course and direction of a war
- {情勢|じょうせい}: situation, circumstances — broader, not limited to war
- {状況|じょうきょう}: situation, conditions — general-purpose word
- {戦線|せんせん}: front line, battle front — refers to the physical line of fighting
